articles.summary: Business Wire: Susan Steinhoff Appointed Chief Underwriting Officer at Hamilton Re. PEMBROKE, Bermuda, January 12, 2026--Hamilton Insurance Group, Ltd. (NYSE: HG) ("Hamilton" or the "Company") announced today the appointment of Susan Steinhoff as Chief Underwriting Officer at Hamilton Re, the Company’s Bermuda-based insurance and reinsurance underwriting platform.
